source_locations: Equations of state for Fo, Wds, Rwd, Akm, Prv, and PPrv

scope: Recoverable room-temperature P-V slices behind the published joint thermoelastic optimizations for MgSiO3 bridgmanite, akimotoite, and post-perovskite.

published_optimization.kind: simultaneous optimization of heat-capacity, thermal-expansion, adiabatic-bulk-modulus, and P-V-T measurements
published_optimization.free_and_fixed_parameter_note: The paper says V0 is usually taken from reference data, K0 is determined from ultrasonic measurements after conversion from KS, k is fixed at 5, and the remaining thermal parameters are fitted. It does not state a phase-specific fixed/free mask, objective function, point-weighting rule, parameter covariance, or unrounded fitted coefficients.
published_optimization.weights: no weighting rule stated; unweighted use of the published points is the primary reproducible interpretation

reconstruction.fit_method: V0 and k=5 fixed to Dorogokupets et al.; K0 and K0_prime fitted primarily to unweighted pressure residuals. A source-error/spread-proxy fit is retained only as a sensitivity check.
reconstruction.weighting_caveat: No inspected source identifies a point-weighting rule for the Dorogokupets optimization. The secondary diagnostic combines the source pressure error or spread proxy with volume uncertainty projected through the published curve. Reynard ice-VII brackets are maximum pressure gradients rather than one-sigma errors; Katsura pressure errors include disagreement between two MgO scales.

pressure_scale.application: Tange and Guignot simultaneous MgO volumes are evaluated directly. Katsura publishes only rounded MgO V/V0; that ratio is applied to the Sokolova reference volume as an explicit approximation.
pressure_scale.implementation_note: Peritheos follows the corrected Sokolova 2016 workbook calculation path for the 2013 scale family. The distinction from the literal 2013 intrinsic-anharmonic equation is negligible for this 298-308 K slice but matters at high temperature.

missing_or_out_of_slice: Ambient-pressure volume-temperature points from Knittle et al. (1986) and Ross and Hazen (1989) constrain the full thermal optimization but are not high-pressure 298 K P-V observations.
The heat-capacity rows from Akaogi et al. (2008) and all heated Katsura/Tange rows are outside this isothermal diagnostic.

included.citation: Reynard et al. (1996), Table 1 and Figure 3

included.selection: T0133 Au-marker pressures mapped from Anderson et al. (1989) to the Sokolova et al. (2013) Au scale; T0150 Decker-NaCl pressures retained as original
complete akimotoite elasticity table; all 55 KS observations enter the independent linear-regression audit

missing_or_out_of_slice: The heated Wang rows and Zhou KS(P,T) observations are bundled but lie outside the 298 K P-V slice; they constrain the full joint thermal/acoustic model.
Ashida et al. (1988) heat-capacity and thermal-expansion observations constrain the full joint model.
akimotoite.source_scale_choice: The 2015 Figure 6 caption says Reynard pressures are retained as original but does not specify ruby versus preferred ice-VII assignment. Both non-independent alternatives are therefore reported.

included.rows: 22 table rows; 21 with post-perovskite volume; 3 at 300 K
included.selection: all printed columns retained; MgO lattice parameters permit Sokolova-scale pressure recalculation

missing_or_out_of_slice: The 18 heated Komabayashi post-perovskite rows are bundled but outside this isothermal diagnostic.
excluded: Ono et al. (2006) Au-scale Table 2 is bundled independently, but Dorogokupets et al. explicitly report a systematic deviation up to 6 GPa for part of that branch and identify only Guignot and Komabayashi as the well-smoothed MgO-scale inputs.

disposition: The three newly supplied primary tables are completely bundled. The 298 K diagnostics are executable and unweighted by default, but the complete 14-parameter joint fit remains only partially reconstructable and exact parity is not claimable.
